args.body: Advance SQLITE-INSTRUCTOR-PREVIEW-STANDALONE-RELEASE under a valid lease. Use the queued standalone-release-inventory.json if committed as a starting inventory. Establish the served baseline from recorded release manifests and use targeted public readbacks only for material gaps. Identify the private-quote revision owner and arrange a hash-verified restoration copy and handoff before changing shared files. If the inventory and handoff are confirmed, stage the preview alone, run the host dry run and send the exact digest and inventory to an eligible independent reviewer. If either prerequisite remains unverified, record which paths or ownership evidence are missing and retain the tested standalone payload. Read back evidence and close under the actual lease with a lesson when the mission criteria are met. Keep this staged.

description: The SQLite instructor preview applied to the verified live baseline, and the learner command passed from the exact archive. The merge into the shared candidate failed where a separate private-quote revision is pending. Build the standalone release inventory and coordinate preservation of that revision before staging. Shared-site staging depends on owner handoff and a verified baseline inventory. Publication depends on host-enforced independent approval of the exact digest. Treasury remains unfunded with no verified revenue. The feedback snapshot has no classified requests and five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown.
